candidate.label: Clean source candidate; evidence files committed afterward.

scope: Make the FP-P1-04 coding journey reach a visible final response and complete undo, plus fail visibly on a terminal provider disconnect.

rootCause.primary: runAgentPrompt wrapped the whole user turn in one RequestAttemptBudget sized maxRetries+1 (default 4) and every provider transport call took a slot, including successful tool rounds. A four-tool loop therefore exhausted the budget and the fifth call (the final answer) failed closed with ProviderRequestAttemptBudgetExhaustedError.
rootCause.surfacing: The OpenAI client wrapped that budget error as APIConnectionError('Connection error.'); the runner classified it as a retryable transport failure and reported FailoverError: LLM request failed: network connection error.
rootCause.secondary: createBashRawOutputCapture allocated its scratch dir eagerly, so an unwritable TEMP made the whole exec tool throw and the tool result was never written back.

fix: request-attempt-budget.ts: completeAttempt() releases the slot when an attempt succeeds; only failed attempts hold retry capacity, so retry layers still share one budget.
bash-raw-output-capture.ts: degrade to a no-op recorder that reports the allocation error in diagnostics instead of throwing.

coding-loop-fp-p1-04.spec.ts: disposable workspace moves under the agent-owned E2E run root (the Gateway child runs at a different integrity level and cannot write to D:\tmp), provider tracing records connection/request/response events, and a terminal-disconnect negative case aborts the final stream after a partial delta only.

terminalDisconnectNegative.test: terminal provider disconnect fails visibly and the next turn succeeds
terminalDisconnectNegative.assertion: UI shows 'Needs attention' and the full success sentence is absent

commands.command: pnpm --dir openclaw_runtime exec vitest run src/agents/request-attempt-budget.test.ts src/agents/provider-outbound-budget.test.ts src/agents/model-fallback.loop-termination.test.ts

commands.counts: all budget rows PASS, 0.00% delta on latency rows

negativeControls: terminal provider disconnect: partial delta then socket destroy; no success-looking final answer is rendered
bash raw-output capture with an unwritable temp root returns a no-op recorder with diagnostics instead of throwing
successful provider attempts release their retry slot; failed attempts keep theirs (runtime unit tests)
limitations: Provider behaviour is the scripted local OpenAI-compatible endpoint; this proves control flow and tool semantics, not live-model quality.
Developer-source Windows x64 Electron evidence only; the packaged/installed artifact is not exercised here.

The workspace relocation works around a Windows integrity boundary between the Electron worker and the Gateway child on this host; it is not evidence that arbitrary TEMP locations are writable by both sides.
No live-provider, packaged, release, or real-human evidence is claimed.
